summary: Hiker on the Gold Creek Lake trail in the Mount Zirkel Wilderness developed altitude-sickness symptoms around 2 p.m.; Classic Air Medical located him but had no landing zone, North Routt Fire made first contact, and 8 RCSAR members packaged him in a vacuum mattress and wheeled him about 2 miles in a stokes litter to the trailhead
location: Gold Creek Lake trail, Mount Zirkel Wilderness
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue (with Classic Air Medical, North Routt Fire)
notes: RCSAR Far Routt Newsletter Fall Edition Nov 2023 (org publication); date from dated mission header
